headline: NYM @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYM 6.52 at WSN 4.58, with a projected total of 11.10. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYM: NYM moved +2.37 runs while WSN moved +0.44, changing the projected margin by +1.94 runs. The projected total climbed +2.81, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Carson Benge, James Wood, Daylen Lile, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags MJ Melendez, Nasim Nuñez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
